name: ULTRASONIC CLEANER WITH FILTRATION SYSTEM
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Ultrasonic Cleaner with Filtration System incorporates an active circulation circuit that continuously filters out particulate contaminants. This design extends cleaning agent life and guarantees zero re-deposit of particles onto sensitive industrial components.
features: Integrated circulation system with filter tank, motor, and filter
Filters out metal chips, fines, and burned carbons during operation
Extends life of cleaning fluids and ensures zero contaminant re-deposit
Digital temperature (35°C to 95°C) and timer controls (0 to 99 hours)
Adjustable ultrasonic power with an external generator

specifications.Filtration System: Includes filter tank, motor and filter
